scientific_integrity: The all-parameter equality follows from an analytic proof. Exact finite tests and independent numerical LP checks are supporting reproducibility, not proof of universal quantifiers. Earlier multipartite heat-variation research already contains the same contraction-threshold condition, so novelty is restricted to the full-time sharp norm and its amplification law.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge, unit-rate combinatorial graph Laplacians on finite complete bipartite graphs; real-valued graph-Lipschitz seminorm. No normalized/weighted or other-graph sharp law asserted. Unindexed earlier exact transport formulas remain possible.
title: Sharp finite-time Lipschitz amplification for heat flow on complete bipartite graphs
